comment: Cool guy, very nice/passionate. 3 tests with a curve, 1 essay. Just listen to lectures, use PowerPoints to study, and you should be fine. I did not understand a lot of what he talked about, but I learned enough to do well in the class. He goes much deeper in his lectures than he does in his tests, so don't panic during the lectures.

Jimbo is the funniest teacher I have ever had at any level. He's also one of those professors who is a retired professional, and thus knows a lot about the material.  His class was fairly easy, though the amount of work you put it doesn't really correspond with your grade. Great guy, and very interesting lectures.

Prof. Wight is a helpful teacher, he is always ready to meet with you outside of class for help.  HOWEVER, his class is very tough, which is very surprising after hearing the pretty good reviews of his class.  His teaching style is middle of the run and he gets off track very easily.
Easiest A you will ever get in school while still learning a lot, highly recommended!

Professor Wright is a teacher that cares about his students both in and out of the classroom.  The class/material is not tough, but that is not his goal. His class is low-stress, yet you learn a lot through discussions and handouts.  This is one of those classes/teachers you need to take during your 4 years at UR...I really enjoyed it.

This class was a joke. No reading is necessary. Barely any real writing. I was ashamed of the department for having this class represent the department to most freshmen interested in education. If I took this class first, I surely sould not be an ed minor. Take it if you want an easy, but boring and disorganized A. (take-home, open-book final!) ugh

This class pretty easy! Mainly discussion and work is graded on completion. Dr. Wright is really flexible and is willing to work with you if you need to turn in an assignment late. TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! One of the easiest and insightful professors I've had here!
